_notes: fk_texdedupe_kit TEXDEDUPE v2. enabled=true: a glb PNG/JPEG image (>= minBytes encoded) with the same 128-bit content hash + byte length + sRGB/linear + mip flag is tagged at decode; when 2+ settled copies exist one GPU-verified shared copy replaces them on every Material and the importers duplicates are destroyed (v2, Assembly-CSharp only). tiers = QualityTiers.Current names it runs on, empty = every tier. One-row revert: enabled false (hot data, applies to the next glb load). Switches: -texdedupe:on / -texdedupe:off. Readable images (glTFast multi-sampler clones) and KTX/WebP are never touched.
